text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon splendidly delivered results 
in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

And Smart Falcon was... singing in front 
of her fans again today.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's a wrap on our regular live 
stream~☆ Thank you all for tuning in this 
week too!”
(Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Falco was the best today too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The sunlight today was just exquisite—it 
made for the absolute best spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When it's cloudy like this, your 
complexion looks completely different, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, Falco's cute all the time, no 
matter what, though♪"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo! Ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I was surprised! To think you're 
still singing on the streets!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're already a top Umadol. You 
can sing on huge stages, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, you put on regular weekly lives. 
Isn't that tough?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fufu. You're right!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The current Falco is worrying about things 
like when the sun's shining...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to handle everything alone, 
from the background music to handing out 
flyers.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course I get help with things like 
lining up the fans and the raffle, though!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
You're working as a manager!? That's so 
cold of you not to tell me!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan D
text_block_list.text:
If you had just asked, we would've helped 
too. We'd do anything for our beloved 
Falco-chan, Manager-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you, everyone♪ But don't 
worry, I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I want everyone to listen to Falco's 
singing!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Wherever my fans are will always be 
Falco's stage!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have feelings I want to 
share, Falco will keep on singing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Tomorrow, the day after, and forever! 
Falco will al~ways be everyone's Uma-dol!☆
